name: Chief Minister’s Free Cancer Chemotherapy Scheme
benefit:
Medicine worth ₹10.00 lakhs per person per annum (₹5.00 lakh for 6 months).
Free Consultation
Free counseling
The benefit of the scheme can be availed during the period of the entire treatment.
_eligibility_text: 1. Regular State Government Employees and their dependents are eligible for the scheme.
